title: Capability-level permissions and usable guardrails

permissionMatrix.reason: mutating scheduled work remains high risk
System shell requires interactive confirmation, full-access mode, or remembered shell grant; read-only always denies
local export/download writes must pass filesystem-profile validation
classified write/admin run commands require stronger boundary

tests.command: $env:PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD='1'; python -m pytest tests/test_ecorex_web_parallel_backend.py -q -k "image_jobs_api_projects_auditable_parallelism_policy or image_jobs_vision_ocr_provider_requires_tool_permission or smart_ask_requires_permission_for_env_config_and_send or non_web_channel_dangerous_tools_still_fail_closed or read_only_blocks_scheduler_mutations or scheduler_background_execution_requires_noninteractive_permission or scheduler_tool_call_checks_target_tool_permission or tool_permission_handler_round_trips_mode_and_audit or default_filesystem_profile_limits_unprofiled_file_access_to_workspace or custom_filesystem_profile_limits_file_tools_to_workspace or web_file_serve_obeys_custom_filesystem_profile"

python -m py_compile common/ecorex_tool_permissions.py agent/protocol/agent_stream.py agent/tools/scheduler/integration.py channel/web/web_channel.py agent/protocol/image_job_service.py agent/protocol/__init__.py

notes: Initial pytest run without plugin isolation failed before collection because a global langsmith pytest plugin imported an incompatible pydantic-core version. Re-run with PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 passed.
Vision/OCR/imagegen provider credential and repair UX remains assigned to S6; S5 only unifies permission semantics and low-risk default access.
All capability authorization decisions write capability-authorization audit records.
Web file/artifact helpers now require explicit boolean allowed=true from authorize_file_access decisions; malformed dicts and MagicMock-like broker return values fail closed.

AgentStream and scheduler legacy broker compatibility now only applies when authorize_capability is absent; malformed authorize_capability return values fail closed instead of falling back to permissive legacy authorize/authorize_noninteractive methods.
Web scheduler/image status paths have deny-path coverage proving they call the capability broker before projections or image job service reads.
Image job parallelism policy moved from the Web handler to the shared agent.protocol.image_job_service runtime layer and is exported through agent.protocol.

Feishu structured install/config/auth actions are no longer default-allowed; read-only blocks them, smart-ask/noninteractive denies without confirmation, and full-access allows them as configure-class actions.
Web external-connection Feishu agent_auth now calls the capability broker before FeishuCli.execute; read-only denial returns a structured permission_denied payload and skips the CLI call.

Multi-agent review found and the implementation fixed: image_jobs not being marked dangerous, Web helper legacy fallback bypass, Web helper non-dict/malformed decision truthiness, Web file-access malformed decision truthiness, AgentStream malformed dict fail-open, AgentStream hybrid malformed-capability permissive-legacy fallback, scheduler malformed dict fail-open, scheduler hybrid malformed-capability permissive-legacy fallback, bash action spoofing via model-supplied action, read-only remembered shell grant bypass, Feishu export/download output write bypass, Feishu structured install/config/auth bypass, Web external-connection Feishu agent_auth direct CLI bypass, bare MagicMock truthiness in legacy broker compatibility, missing all-mode low-risk matrix coverage, missing Web status broker-deny tests, and Web-only image job parallelism policy.
